title: Scaling Language Models: Methods, Analysis and Insights from Training Gopher
authors: J. Rae, S. Borgeaud, T. Cai, et al. (80 authors)
before: GPT-3 was the reference point, with limited public analysis of what scale does.
problem: Which capabilities improve with scale, and which do not?
breakthrough: A 280B model evaluated across 152 tasks, showing gains concentrated in knowledge tasks and much weaker in reasoning.
why: It supplied the careful evaluation that scaling claims lacked, and the compute budget Chinchilla reanalysed.
next: Chinchilla used the same budget to show Gopher was badly undertrained.
inherits: The habit of broad, task-by-task evaluation of scale.
